summary: Frontend-only verification of Sacred Pause bug fix on tryHimandsee Ministries site. All user-reported issues are resolved: (1) the Web Audio chime + bell toggle have been fully removed, and (2) the 'A Sacred Pause' title plus inhale/exhale wording and scripture reference are now visible and properly aligned at the top of the overlay.
critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing (out of scope for this bug): homepage triggers multiple 404s on /api/impact-stats, /api/progress, /api/testimonies (Axios errors logged on every page load). Not related to the Sacred Pause fix but should be addressed by main agent in a future iteration.

BreathingPrayer overlay's title/orb/phrase render in document flow (no min-height on inner flex column) — current layout works on desktop 1920x1080, but on shorter viewports the orb may push the phrase below the fold. Acceptable since overflow-y-auto is set.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified end-to-end on the public preview URL (https://himandsee-faith.preview.emergentagent.com). Verified via Playwright: trigger click opens overlay; no [data-testid='breathing-prayer-chime-toggle'] in DOM; window.AudioContext never instantiated (0 instances) — confirmed via add_init_script hook that wraps AudioContext before page load. Note: page contains 1 <audio> tag, but that belongs to the SEPARATE 'Tap for soft worship music' feature in the page footer area, NOT to BreathingPrayer.jsx (which has no <audio> element). Title 'A Sacred Pause' bounding box y=48 (top of overlay). Phrase 'Breathe in… Be still' shown initially, transitioned to 'Breathe out… and know that I am God' after ~6.5s — confirms phase machine still works. Scripture ref '— Psalm 46:10' shown. Close button removes the overlay. No audio/AudioContext-related console errors. The only console errors are pre-existing 404s on impact-stats/progress/testimonies endpoints — unrelated to this bug.
